Holloway sacked by Swindon after two seasons
- Published
Manager Ian Holloway has been sacked by Swindon Town after just over two years in charge.
The Robins' 2-0 loss at Newport County on Saturday left them 17th in League Two and was their fourth successive loss in all competitions - conceding 10 goals in the process.
They have won just two of their last 15 matches going back to the start of September and, at the beginning of October, Holloway described himself as a "dead man walking" if the team's form did not turn around.
- Swindon's Holloway labels himself dead man walking 
  - Published2 October
Holloway was appointed in October 2024 initially on a deal until the end of that season, with the club at the time a place off the relegation zone.
He surpassed 1,000 games managing in English football two months later and went on to sign a new two-year deal in March 2025, having steered Swindon clear of the drop and into play-off contention form.
Promotion was the aim last season with Holloway issuing a rallying call at the start of the campaign for Swindon to be the "team I believe we can" be.
Things started well, with the Robins in the top five of the table from August 2025 and in the automatic promotion spots in February, but a run of three wins in their final 13 games saw them fall to seventh and they lost 2-1 to Chesterfield in a must-win final match of the campaign to miss the play-offs.
The slump in form has continued as the 2026-27 season started, and while they did win three of their first five league games, they are winless in their past five (four losses, one draw), scoring just one goal in that time.
More to follow.

מועדון הכדורגל סווינדון טאון הודיע על פיטוריו של המאמן איאן האלאוויי לאחר תקופה של קצת יותר משנתיים בתפקיד. ההחלטה התקבלה בעקבות הפסד חוץ 2-0 לניופורט קאונטי, שהותיר את הקבוצה במקום ה-17 בליגה השנייה והיה הפסדה הרצוע הרצוף הרביעי בכל המסגרות.

האלאוויי מונה לתפקיד באוקטובר 2024 וחתם בהמשך על חוזה חדש, אך הקבוצה נקלעה לבצורת והשיגה שני ניצחונות בלבד מתוך 15 משחקי הליגה האחרונים שלה מאז חודש ספטמבר. בעקבות המצב המקדמי והיכולת הירודה של הקבוצה מאז פתיחת עונת 2026-2027, הנהלת המועדון החליטה לסיים את עבודתו.
